<title level="1" pfs="">[Fantooth School](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3276)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

The fearsome teeth of this fish are so massive that it's difficult for the creature to close its mouth. These fish must consider even much larger creatures as possible food, rising towards the surface during the darkness of night.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Animal](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 18

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 16

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 13
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 3">[Fantooth School](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3276)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Large" />
<trait label="Animal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=531" />
<trait label="Aquatic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=533" />
<trait label="Swarm" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=707" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 149

**Perception** +11; [low-light vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=69), [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 120 feet, [wavesense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=84) ([precise](/Rules.aspx?ID=411)) 15 feet

**Languages**

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) +9, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) +5

<row gap="medium">
**Str** -2

**Dex** +3

**Con** +2

**Int** -5

**Wis** +2

**Cha** -3
</row>

**Sunless Sight** While in [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407), the fangtooth fish school is [blinded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=59) and [slowed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92).

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 18 

**Fort** +11 

**Ref** +10 

**Will** +9 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 40

</row>

**Immunities**
precision, [swarm mind](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=78)

**Resistances**
bludgeoning 5, piercing 2, slashing 5

**Weaknesses**
area damage 5, [splash](/Traits.aspx?ID=699) damage 5

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** swim 30 feet

**Bite and Gnaw** <actions string="Single Action" />  Each enemy in the school's space takes 2d8 piercing damage (DC 19 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save).

</column>
